test_title: PYST 18: SSC MTS 2024 - Reasoning Ability and Problem Solving (Held On: 16 Oct, 2024 - Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question: A, B, C, D, E and F are sitting around a circular table facing the centre (but not necessarily in the same order). F sits third to the left of A. D sits to the immediate left of A. C sits second to the right of A. Only E sits between A and C. When counted from right of A, who sits to the immediate left of B?
solution:
Given:

A, B, C, D, E and F are sitting around a circular table facing the centre.

1) F sits third to the left of A.

2) D sits to the immediate left of A.

3) C sits second to the right of A. Only E sits between A and C.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2099e14f44175332e84ac58da0c5cf339351448413a435ff1d3de4f72d05cb88.png] 

So, 'F' sits to the immediate left of B.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option (3)".**
